title: ProME: Prototype-Margin Environments with Repair-Aware Selection for Group-Robust Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.13190v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Group-robust learning is crucial for maintaining accuracy on rare subpopulations when training-group labels are unavailable. However, existing methods often infer environments from a separate reference model and select representations before fitting the classifier used at deployment, leaving both decisions misaligned with the deployed predictor. In this work, we formulate group robustness without training-group labels as the endogenous environments with repair-aware selection (ERAS) problem, and propose ProME (Prototype-Margin Environments) to align both decisions with the deployed predictor. ProME splits prototype margins at their median to construct approximately balanced environments along the training trajectory, and fits a group-balanced linear head on group-annotated validation data to rank the resulting predictors by validation worst-group accuracy. translated_title: ProME：具有修复感知选择的原型边界环境用于群体鲁棒学习
translated_abstract: 群体鲁棒学习对于在缺乏训练群体标签的情况下维持稀有子群体的准确性至关重要。然而，现有方法通常从独立的参考模型中推断环境，并在拟合部署时使用的分类器之前选择表示，这使得这两个决策与部署的预测器不一致。在本工作中，我们将无训练群体标签的群体鲁棒性形式化为具有修复感知选择的内生环境（ERAS）问题，并提出ProME（原型边界环境）来使这两个决策与部署的预测器对齐。ProME在训练轨迹上将原型边界按中位数分割，以构建近似平衡的环境，并在群体标注的验证数据上拟合群体平衡的线性头，通过验证最差群体准确性对所得预测器进行排序。我们在理论上限定了固定环境中推断环境上的最差风险。
tldr: 本文提出ProME方法，通过原型边界分割构建平衡环境并与部署预测器对齐，以解决无训练群体标签时的群体鲁棒学习问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ProME, which constructs balanced environments by splitting prototype margins and aligns them with the deployed predictor to address group-robust learning without training-group labels.
